questions.question: What was Saul searching for when he came to Samuel?
options: A bride from a distant town
A word from the seer Samuel

questions.question: What was notable about Saul's appearance?
options: He was bent and worn down by his great age
He was ruddy and had a very handsome face
He was lame and crippled in both of his feet
He was tall, head and shoulders above others
questions.answer: He was tall, head and shoulders above others

questions.question: God had revealed to Samuel that Saul would be the one to lead Israel.
Saul was without equal among the Israelites — a head _____ than any of the people.
Saul was from the tribe of _____, the smallest tribe of Israel.
